context.transcript:
Thanks for your help planning tomorrow's community health fair.
It was a big job and should get our event planning company more clients this spring.
Yes, it's good that we're allowed to hold it at the local high school since so many people are coming.
Oh, I just got a text message from the yoga instructor.
She isn't feeling well and can't come tomorrow.
That's too bad.
And we don't have time to find a replacement on such short notice.
Looks like we can't have the yoga courses after all.
Hmm.
We still have to buy prizes for the raffle tomorrow.
How about we go to the department store and get them after work tonight?
context.transcript_translation:
感谢您帮助策划明天的社区健康博览会。
这是一项大工程，应该能让我们活动规划公司在这个春天吸引更多的客户。
是的，我们被允许在当地的高中举办这个活动，因为很多人要来，这是件好事。
哦，我刚刚收到瑜伽教练发来的短信。
她感觉不舒服，明天不能来了。
太糟糕了。
而且我们没有时间这么短的通知下找一个替代者。
看来我们最终无法进行瑜伽课程了。
嗯。
我们仍然需要在明天为抽奖活动购买奖品。
不如我们下班后去百货公司买吧？
